openFindings.title: A sibling link that resolves back inside the tree is refused with the wrong reason
layoutLinks paths escape the tree root unvalidated, and the relayout rollback now writes through them
The commit gate can resolve the tree one level too deep and then report a missing engine instead of a missing manifest
The committed overlay manifest pins an absolute local checkout path
Git write gate fails open and silently through its CLI entrypoint
A missing prompt-card guard skips its check with no message
The pinned-blob reader passes a manifest value to git without --end-of-options
A checked completion criterion does not reproduce
The three staged-list scans in pre-commit disagree on which change types they see
The packet's last completion criterion understates the phase count
